👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `b2705a9`: all 28 files reviewed.

6 finding(s): 1 to fix, 5 to consider; 6 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 is solid overall. The new code copies the capture toast's window pattern, parses everything that crosses IPC and keeps `shared/` free of value imports. One `fix`: nothing closes the floating card before a screenshot or recording, unlike the toast, which is dismissed first. With no timer, the card relies on content protection alone, which the app itself treats as unreliable on older Windows builds. Three `consider` findings: the main-window-only `recording-ready:show` handler never checks who sent it; Back re-floats the card because the asked-once ref resets on remount; and a docstring line in `PostRecordingCard` is stale.

**Batch 2 of 2.** Part 2 covers the renderer wiring, tests, CSS, docs and messages. The recording page now waits until the file has been read, asks main once per arrival to show the floating card, and falls back to the in-app card only when main answers false or the IPC call fails. The new render target and the hand-off hook are set up the same way as the capture toast's. The tests check what their names say, and the docs and messages match the code. There are two suggestions, both rated "consider". First, gating on the file read means that if the read stalls, the user gets no card at all; the old in-app card showed immediately. Second, the floating card stays up after the user leaves the page or deletes the recording, so its buttons can lead to a page for a file that no longer exists.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (8 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Main window asks main to float the card (`recording-ready:show` invoke) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:104`) — The floating card appears top-right of the recorded display once the card renderer sends `card-ready` (recording-ready-window.ts:108-112, 218-226). If it fails: If window creation throws, the handler returns false and the page shows the in-app card (use-floating-ready-card.ts:26-28). If the renderer loads but never reports ready, the handler still returns tr… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:104-107`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:134-147`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:786`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:21-29`.
- Card action hands off to the main window (`recording-ready:open`) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:899-902`) — useRecordingReadyHandOffs navigates to Prepare, the editor or the detail page (use-recording-ready-hand-offs.ts:13-33). If it fails: If there is no mainWindow at send time, sendToRenderer returns silently, but showMainWindow has just created it. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:145-150`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:449-457`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-recording-ready-hand-offs.ts:28-34`.
- Hub records the display of the latest take (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:666`) — Picks the display where the ready card opens. If it fails: If the lookup resolves after stop, the start-time value (or null) is kept. In that case the card falls back to the display under the cursor. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:646`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:707-714`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:237-244`.
- Card left up across a later screenshot or recording (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:208`) — On platforms where content protection fails, the card is captured into the output. If it fails: The card appears silently in the user's screenshot or video (old Windows per area-geometry.ts:87-92). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:670`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-toast-window.ts:305-307`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/area-geometry.ts:87-92`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:647-735`.
- Detail page asks for the floating card once per arrival (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:16-31`) — On Back to the same history entry, the floating card is asked for again. If it fails: A rejected IPC sets the fallback key, so the in-app card shows. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:129-155`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:17-28`.
- Recording page asks main to float "Your video is ready" once per arrival, after the probe settles (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:141`) — Main creates or reuses a frameless window and shows it inactive once the card renderer reports ready. The in-app card stays hidden unless the fallback fires. If it fails: An IPC rejection or a false answer falls back to the in-app card. A window that is created but never loads shows nothing (acknowledged in the doc's Not done section). A probe that never settles block… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:16-31`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:130-155`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-66`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:104-147`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:219-226`.
- New render target ?window=recording-ready mounts RecordingReadyCard (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:66`) — The body gets 16px of padding around the card and does not scroll. The card reports the frame's height, and main sizes the window to that height plus 2×16. If it fails: A renderer crash is forwarded under the 'recording-ready' origin. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:60-71`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/assets/main.css:85-93`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/recording-ready-card.tsx:40-53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:70-80`.
- Main window subscribes to floating-card hand-offs and navigates (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/app-root.tsx:31`) — A chip opens /prepare/:id?to=..., Edit first opens /editor/video/:id and Open opens /library/:id in the main window. If it fails: No async work in the renderer. A hand-off for a recording deleted meanwhile lands on a not-found page (see finding). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-recording-ready-hand-offs.ts:28-34`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-recording-ready-hand-offs.test.ts:5-17`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:166-172`.
